text:
elena-cs: FYI PioneerCare reported high p95/p99 for chat completions & embeddings since ~08:10 PST. They see 3-5x latency and some 503s. forwarding customer logs below.
elena-cs: from PioneerCare: "Started a large indexing job at 08:05 using bulk-embeds endpoint. Since then tail latency jumped, notebook jobs time out. We pay for Dedicated but still see spikes. Can you advise?"
ryan-sre: ACK. tagging @sam-eng and @liam-ml. Any quick checks we can run?
sam-eng: pulling metrics now. prometheus query: `sum(rate(api_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~"/v1/embeddings|/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le,tenant)` to inspect tail.
sam-eng: quick glance: PioneerCare tenant shows a huge p99 bump at 08:06 and sustained. Also GPU utilization on shared pool nodes spiked ~90% around then.
liam-ml: could be a noisy bulk embedding job that's disabling effective KV/prefix caching on the serving layer. If they flood with many short independent contexts, batching/caching efficiency collapses.
elena-cs: PioneerCare claims job is 100k documents, small size, many parallel requests from 40 workers. They expected batching to absorb it.
ryan-sre: checking per-tenant rate policy and throttles: config shows PioneerCare is on standard plan (no dedicated pool). But they had previously asked about reserved capacity and said they'd toggle later.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0174 PioneerCare p99 spike (channel: customer-success).
sam-eng: reading kernel logs on node set pool-3: rx queue backpressure and sporadic PCIe stalls — might be exacerbated by concurrent memcpy ops from many ff pass threads.
liam-ml: we should verify if their requests are hitting the same model variant and causing KV cache thrash. Querying runtime traces: `select count(*) from request_traces where tenant="pioneercare" and span="kv_miss" and ts > 1769420000`
sam-eng: trace shows kv_miss rate up 12x for that tenant. So indeed caching is being undermined.
ryan-sre: mitigation proposal: 1) apply temporary soft-quota (concurrency cap) to PioneerCare at the API gateway; 2) route their traffic to a background batch pool to stabilize latency for others; 3) offer to migrate to a reserved Dedicated slot. Thoughts?
elena-cs: I'll ask PioneerCare if they can tolerate a temporary concurrency cap (e.g., 10 concurrent).
PioneerCare (via email forwarded): "We need embedding run to finish within 24h but can throttle concurrency if it prevents tenant-wide impact. Prefer we keep it running."
ryan-sre: ok implement soft-concurrency cap to 12 for tenant pioneercare for next 2 hours. Command: `curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/tenants/pioneercare/limits -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' -d '{"concurrency":12,"reason":"mitigate noisy bulk embed"}'`
sam-eng: done. Adding traffic routing rule to move new embed requests into the low-priority batch queue. config snippet: ```json
{"route":"/v1/embeddings","match":{"tenant":"pioneercare","header":"x-bulk-job:true"},"target":"batch-pool-2","priority":"low"}```
liam-ml: also enabled per-tenant ephemeral cache pinning (experimental) to isolate their KV namespace. Applied flag `runtime.kv.isolate=true` on their requests for the batch pool.
ryan-sre: after changes, p99 for other tenants returned to baseline within 2 minutes. PioneerCare still has longer job duration but no 503s.
elena-cs: PioneerCare confirms 503s stopped, overall job progressing, they accept the temporary cap. :thumbsup:
liam-ml: root cause summary: large number of small, parallel embed requests bypassed batching and invalidated shared KV caching patterns, causing destructive cache churn + GPU memcpy pressure on shared serving nodes. Not a single-device hardware failure.
sam-eng: follow-ups: 1) add autoscaling rule to spin up dedicated batch pool when any tenant's embed qps > X for > Y minutes; 2) introduce tenant-level embed concurrency warnings to CS before throttles; 3) add a documented best-practice for bulk-embeds (use batched payloads or the bulk ingest endpoint).
elena-cs: I'll schedule a customer call to offer migration path to Dedicated/reserved capacity and share best-practices doc.
ryan-sre: reopening runtime issue for tracking: RUNTIME-4561 - implement tenant isolation knobs + autoscale triggers.
ops-bot: Task created: TASK-8893 (add embedding bulk guides to docs).
elena-cs: tagging for postmortem: @sam-eng @liam-ml @ryan-sre — can someone write a short post-incident note we can share with PioneerCare?
sam-eng: I'll draft timeline + queries used. liam will add ML-side explanation.
liam-ml: will draft cache/serving explainer and mitigation steps we took.
ryan-sre: closing note: customer in stable state, agreed to review Dedicated options. Will follow up with timeline doc and billing credit proposal per SLO breach policy.
elena-cs: thanks all. closing thread once the post-incident note is in GDrive.
